_doc: Hanging guard on the arm's LEFT: hand at (x, z), sword pitched `pitch` deg (down), pan -20. tol = pitch tolerance for the pose search.

_help.pitch: sword angle (deg; negative = pointing down): -45 = hanging guard
_help.tol: allowed deviation from pitch in the pose search (deg)
_help.captured.end: pose captured from the arm (real degrees). Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
_help.captured_B.end: pose captured from ARM B (real degrees); applies only to arm B. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
